from torch.nn import functional as F


def q466(
    policy_logits,
    value_predictions,
    policy_targets,
    value_targets,
    parameters=(),
    l2=0,
):
    policy = (
        -(policy_targets * F.log_softmax(policy_logits, dim=-1))
        .sum(-1)
        .mean()
    )
    value = F.mse_loss(
        value_predictions.reshape(-1), value_targets.reshape(-1)
    )
    return (
        policy
        + value
        + l2
        * sum((p.square().sum() for p in parameters), policy.new_zeros(()))
    )
